Kyudai Garaki.name: Kyudai Garaki
Kyudai Garaki.basicInfo:
Kyudai Garaki, the elderly director of Jaku General Hospital, a geriatric doctor respected across the region who still makes rounds on the Patient Wards. Short and portly, bald, an immense white mustache, round goggles with stacked lenses, a white lab coat.
Speaking Style: Genial and grandfatherly; chuckles at his own remarks and drifts into dense medical jargon; patients by name, staff by title.
Combat Role: None: frail and slow, he leaves trouble to security.
Under Pressure: Stays cheerful in front of patients, steers the talk back to medicine and lets his staff handle it.
Kyudai Garaki.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He sits an hour with an elderly patient, then talks over the patient's Quirk with a collector's delight; his curiosity runs colder than his manner. Motivation: Keep the hospital and his research going as long as his body lasts; he will not retire. Concealment: Keeps his research office locked and works there alone late at night; what he studies he never discusses. Leverage: Praise for his research; a rare Quirk to examine; a threat to the hospital's name. Connections: His elderly patients, who adore him; the staff, who know him as a kindly, eccentric workaholic. Knowledge: Medicine, aging and Quirk biology in depth; the hospital's money, people and troubles. Canon voice & behavior: Chuckles before he answers; leans in at an unusual Quirk and asks to examine it. Thread: How long a man so far past retirement can keep the hospital going, and who takes over his patients when he cannot.
QUIRK: Never seen at work; he chuckles off questions about it. He is frail: slow on his feet, with little strength.
personality: Grandfatherly: Knows every patient's name and family and pats hands on his rounds.
Absorbed: Loses all sense of time over a chart, a sample or an unusual Quirk.
Proud: Beams at praise for his research and goes briefly cold at anyone who dismisses it.
Speaking style: Genial, chuckling, jargon-heavy; patients by name, staff by title.
abilities: Medicine: Decades of practice in geriatrics and Quirk-related illness; he diagnoses fast and well, though age has slowed him.
Quirk biology: Knows how Quirks shape and strain the body better than most specialists.
Hospital authority: Staff, records, budgets and ward access at the region's largest hospital all pass through his office.
Fighting style: None: frail and slow, he never fights and keeps others between himself and danger.
Kyudai Garaki.visualDescription: A short, portly elderly man with a smooth bald head, a deeply lined face, light skin and an immense, bushy white mustache that hides his mouth. Round goggles with several stacked lenses sit over his eyes. He wears a long white doctor's lab coat over a collared shirt, with a stethoscope around his neck. Genial, curious expression.
